**Overview**
Job Description
  
  
The Capgemini DCX Foundry redefines the way customer experience (CX) is crafted, blending technology, design, and data-driven insights to create immersive and impactful solutions, that drive business outcome. By adopting a customer journey-centric approach combined with industry-tailored strategies, we customize each customer experience to align with their unique business requirements, moving beyond just technology-centric solutions.
  
  
Business Advisors shape the vision with the client, understand the needs of the users/stakeholders, carry out an elicitation of processes, data and capabilities and derive the target processes and the business requirements for the current and future solution.
  
  
**Primary Skills**

* Excellent understanding of D365 Sales, Customer Service
* At least 2 end to end project as a Technical BA on a D365 engagement
* At least 2 end to end project configuring out of the box sales , service and marketing modules of D365
* Strong understanding of Security Model in D365
* Strong Digital experience

**Deliverables**

* Collaborate with UX and design team in prototyping for further fine turn requirement
* Create requirement in User stories with acceptance scenarios, preferably in BDD support format (in feature file format)
* Collaborate with dev team on daily basis
* Participate in Spring planning, spring review, backlog refinement meetings

**Job Description - Grade Specific**
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Requirement gathering and Analysis
* Facilitating the review and approval of requirements from all stakeholders
* Facilitating and participation in design discussion and workshops
* Writing user stories, conducting grooming sessions and story walkthroughs
* Providing first sign-off on the development post Dev testing
* Giving demo to the Product Owner and other stakeholders for final sign-off
* Support UAT, SIT and Production
* Collaborating with partner system BAs and other stakeholders- Stakeholder Management
* Preparation of use case diagrams, UMLs, Sequence diagrams, Visio flows
* Be the interface between the business, the customers, and their product related needs on one side, and the Team on the other
* Buffer the Team from feature and bug-fix requests that come from many sources, and is the single point of contact for all questions about product requirements for the team
* Act as proxy Product Owner
* Work closely with the team to define the user-facing and technical requirements, to document the requirements as needed, and to determine the order of their implementation.
* Impacts analysis of change requests on the existing business flows
* Help the POs decide the fitment of those change requests into existing business flows without additional development effort

Jaggaer One connects Source-to-Contract, Procure-to-Pay and Supplier Intelligence, with embedded AI (JAI) that helps teams move faster, stay compliant and make better decisions. Our platform supports a supplier community of more than 13 million and manages $2.9 trillion in annual spend.

Over the course of this 18-month program, you'll build specialized expertise through hands-on experience, structured learning, and mentorship from industry leaders. **About Reap**
Reap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries. We enable financial connectivity and access for businesses worldwide by combining traditional finance with stablecoins for efficient money movement.
  
  
Through our stablecoin-powered corporate cards, payments, and expense management tools, we streamline financial operations and help businesses scale. Our APIs enable businesses to integrate stablecoin-enabled finance into their own products and services—from issuing Visa cards to facilitating cross-border payments.
  
  
Backed by leading investors including Acorn Pacific, Index Ventures and HashKey Capital, Reap is building the future of borderless, stablecoin-enabled finance.
  
  
Reap is building financial infrastructure for modern businesses. Our products help companies issue cards, move money, manage payments, and scale financial operations across markets.
  
  
As our products and client base grow, the journey from sales to activation is becoming more technical and more important. We are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer who can help clients go from “interested” to “live and successful” faster, with the right technical guidance along the way.
  
  
**The team**
You’ll join a lean, experienced risk team and work with colleagues across Reap’s global business, including the data team. The team offers a flexible hybrid or remote work environment, the use of AI tools at work, and space to learn and experiment in a culture of innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning.
  
  
**The opportunity**
This is a high-impact, senior individual contributor role at the frontier of stablecoin-powered finance. You’ll own strategic projects that shape Reap’s expansion into new markets and help build the risk infrastructure that makes growth possible. It suits someone energised by ownership, complex problem-solving, and work at the intersection of traditional finance and emerging technology.

* Evaluate and onboard new BIN sponsorship clients through structured risk analysis. Establish initial risk configurations and maintain governance oversight of the sponsored portfolio.
* Design and implement automated monitoring workflows for fraud alerts, scheme notifications, and client- and merchant-level risk signals, reducing manual intervention and improving response times.
* Lead deep-dive fraud investigations, BIN attack incident response, post-mortems, and cross-functional coordination.
* Build the dashboards and risk intelligence the team relies on, partnering with the data team to surface fraud and risk signals. With no dedicated risk data analyst today, you’ll shape how risk data is presented and acted on.
* Advise clients on their risk appetite and fraud exposure, helping define controls and thresholds appropriate to their business model. Act as a trusted risk partner throughout the relationship.
* Use risk metrics, dashboards, and analytical tools to make evidence-based decisions and communicate them clearly to stakeholders.

**What You Bring**

* At least eight years of risk management experience in a card issuer or acquirer environment, with a strong background in card fraud, disputes, and risk operations.
* The ability to own projects from beginnin

**Description**
This Product Manager will drive customer pricing for Amazon South Africa. This is a product role that will require the incumbent to build and execute roadmaps for Pricing and Price Perception. It also has a critical analytics component to it given the need to work with and build data-driven models that inform our pricing and deals strategy.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As part of this role, the PM will be responsible for
  
  
Building a country-level product and program road map working with (and spanning) 3P Domestic, 3P OOC, Retail and Global Store with the main aim of making Amazon the lowest priced retailer for our customers,
  
  
Rolling out WW best practices and initiatives that help Price Perception for Amazon in South Africa.
  
  
Work with Marketing/Merchandizing to create the right price perception build-up strategy on our key website assets,
  
  
Create the right offline price perception management strategy – as offline is a key part of how SIC drives price perception in our marketplaces, and finally
  
  
lead the pricing product portfolio across products that automate pricing, or build trust with customers. This role will lead pricing product and program for Amazon in South Africa.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of product management experience
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in product, program, or project management in leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of SQL and VBA at an advanced level
* Experience building and analyzing cost/benefit scenarios and business cases and communicating results throughout the organization

jobs.description:
BNESIM, the World's Best Travel eSIM, recently awarded for the 7th time, is a company operating in the Telecom for Travel sector, a global connectivity solutions provider offering eSIM and international SIM services for travelers, digital nomads, and businesses working across borders, with coverage in over 200 countries and regions. We are looking for an AI Data Analytics Intern to join our Data & Analytics team in Dubai and help turn data into clear, actionable insight for a fast-paced global business.

BNESIM is a fully agentic company, where AI drives how work gets done. In this role, AI is your primary tool and working method, not the subject of your work. You will use AI tools and agents every day to analyze data, build reports and dashboards, and develop workflows, executing tasks autonomously from start to finish. This is an ideal fit for a recent STEM graduate who is sharp, curious, and already AI-native in how they think and work.

This is a 6-month, full-time, on-site contract with a clear path to convert into a 2-year contract for strong performers. You will gain hands-on exposure to real telecom data, work alongside an experienced analytics team, and learn how a modern, AI-first organization operates at global scale. If you want to shape the future of how data work is done, this is a great place to start your career.

Analyze commercial, customer, and usage data across BNESIM's eSIM and international connectivity products using AI tools and agents to surface trends and insights

Build and maintain recurring reports and dashboards that give stakeholders a clear view of key business metrics

Design and run AI-powered workflows and agents that automate data collection, cleaning, and reporting tasks

Translate analytical findings into concise, visual summaries and recommendations for team and business stakeholders

Validate data quality and accuracy by cross-checking AI-generated outputs against source data and flagging inconsistencies

Partner with the Data & Analytics team to scope ad-hoc analysis requests and deliver results independently within agreed timelines

Document workflows, prompts, and methodologies so that analyses and automations can be reused across the team

**Nice to have**

* Python for data analysis
* SQL
* Power BI or Tableau
* Knowledge of the telecom or eSIM industry
* Degree in a STEM field such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or Engineering

jobs.title: Digital Operations & AI Automation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Work directly with the founder of Entreproneur**

At Entreproneur, we help entrepreneurs build and grow their own e-commerce businesses. I’m looking for someone to work alongside me as my right hand in the business. Some days I’ll come to you with a specific idea. Other days, you’ll spot a coach doing the same task for the fifth time and come to me with a better way to get it done.

The skill I value most is **the ability to connect AI tools with the systems our team already uses and turn manual tasks into reliable workflows**. For example, could you take a recorded coaching session, generate a summary, and create follow-up tasks for the right people in our project system? Could you turn one webinar into a week of social content, with clips and captions ready for someone to review and schedule? If you enjoy figuring out how those pieces fit together and building something people actually use, I’d like to hear from you.

What you’ll do

* **Build AI automations.** Work with the team to identify repetitive tasks, connect the right tools, and test the workflow from start to finish. Once it’s live, check how much time it saves and whether the team can rely on it.
* **Improve how we manage projects in Odoo.** Build rules for reminders, task assignments, and follow-ups so our coaches know which students need attention and what needs to happen next. Coordinate meetings and follow up directly when something needs a person’s attention.
* **Build and improve websites.** Design and publish websites and landing pages, review how visitors use them, and make changes where the design or flow could work better.
* **Automate parts of our content production.** Connect the steps between an original recording or idea and a post that’s ready for review. Help us publish consistently across Entreproneur’s social channels while keeping the content in our own voice.
* **Run and analyse ad campaigns.** Use campaign and website data to understand what’s working, decide what to test, and put those changes into practice.
* **Work with our developer on custom solutions.** You’ll own what you can build yourself. When an idea needs custom code, you’ll explain what the team needs, give the developer a clear brief, and test the result with the people who will use it.

**What you bring**  
You’ve built websites or landing pages yourself, have an eye for design, and understand the basics of digital advertising and website analytics. You’re comfortable finding your way around a CRM, ERP, or project management platform. You can learn Odoo on the job, and coding experience is optional.

**Hands-on experience building connected AI workflows carries the most weight in this role.** That could mean using Make, n8n, Zapier, native integrations, or similar tools. You understand what starts a workflow, what information needs to move between systems, where AI adds value, and how to spot when something goes wrong.

Odoo is the main system we use to manage student projects, coordinate coaching, and track follow-ups. You can learn Odoo on the job. What matters most is that you can look at how our team works, spot a manual step, and connect the right tools to automate it.

**What it’s like to work with me**  
I move quickly, and priorities can change during the day. I value someone who asks the right questions, builds a first version I can try, and tells me when there’s a simpler way to achieve the same result. I also need someone I can hand an idea to and trust to follow it through,

jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced **Senior Accountant** with a strong background in the **FMCG sector (food or non-food)** and hands-on expertise in **Odoo ERP**. The successful candidate will oversee all accounting functions, financial reporting, inventory accounting, and ensure full compliance with UAE regulatory and government requirements.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end-to-end accounting operations, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable.
* Prepare accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
* Handle inventory accounting, stock reconciliations, costing, and margin analysis within an FMCG environment.
* Ensure accurate and timely financial transactions in **Odoo ERP**.
* Monitor cash flow, budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance.
* Ensure compliance with **UAE government regulations**, including VAT filings, Corporate Tax requirements, ESR (if applicable), and other statutory obligations.
* Liaise with government authorities, auditors, banks, and regulatory bodies as required.
* Prepare and submit all regulatory reports and maintain up-to-date financial records in accordance with UAE laws.
* Support annual external audits and internal audit processes.
* Strengthen internal controls and ensure compliance with company policies and accounting standards.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to management for business decision-making.

Requirements

* Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 **years of experience in FMCG (Food or Non-Food)**.
* **Mandatory hands-on experience with Odoo ERP.**
* Strong knowledge of inventory accounting, costing, and financial reporting.
* Proven experience handling **government compliance, VAT, Corporate Tax, and regulatory reporting** in the UAE.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume FMCG environment.

Preferred

* Immediate or short notice period.
* Strong understanding of UAE commercial, tax, and financial regulations.

Application Question(s):

* How many years of accounting experience do you have in the FMCG industry?
* Have you worked in Food FMCG, Non-Food FMCG, or both? What brand?
* How many years of hands-on experience do you have with Odoo ERP?
* Which Odoo accounting modules have you used?
* What is your current salary package?
* What is your salary expectation?
* Are you willing to attend an in-person interview?

Work Location: In person
